department: Department of Civil and Architectural Engineering

deadline.value: International graduate application deadline for Fall entry is June 1, 2027 (apply earlier for assistantship/fellowship consideration; financial aid priority deadline is January 15).
deadline.quote: Fall applications must be submitted by June 1

fee_waiver.value: The Department of Civil and Architectural Engineering explicitly states that an application fee is required and cannot be waived.
fee_waiver.quote: An application fee is required. We are unable to waive the application fee.

gre_general.value: Effective Summer 2024 onwards, the Frank H. Dotterweich College of Engineering does not require the GRE for graduate admissions (superseding older departmental catalog/webpage text).
gre_general.quote: effective Summer 2024 onwards | GRE: GRE is not required for admissions.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics, and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Contacting faculty is recommended; direct B.S.-to-Ph.D. entry requires a faculty member willing to advise the student (otherwise admission is conditional on earning an M.S. first).
supervisor.quote: Must have faculty willing to advise the student; otherwise he/she would be provisionally admitted into the Ph.D. program with a condition that they obtain a M.S. degree.

funding.value: Applicants are automatically evaluated for fellowships by the College of Graduate Studies, and limited departmental research and teaching assistantships are available (supplemented by PI grant funding).
funding.quote: The College of Graduate Studies automatically evaluates graduate applicants for fellowship opportunities. Limited research and teaching assistantship positions exist through the department, as well.

also.quote: Departments may have limited teaching assistantships available to support Ph.D. students. Research assistantship funding, if any, is at the discretion of the grant Principal Investigator and/or the major advisor.

entry_route.value: Applicants may enter after an M.S. degree (63 credit hours) or directly after a B.S. degree (93 credit hours).
entry_route.quote: This doctoral program requires 63 credit hours for students who have previously completed an M.S. degree. Students who have completed only a B.S. may be admitted directly into the Ph.D. in Engineering program but will need to complete 93 credit hours.

notes: Civil Engineering specialization within the college-wide Engineering, Ph.D.
name: Engineering, Ph.D. (Civil Engineering)
